# TypeMatchup

> TypeMatchup is an independent, fan-made Pokemon type matchup reference with calculators, charts, Pokemon pages, and strategy guides.

TypeMatchup helps players and guide writers understand Pokemon weaknesses, resistances, immunities, dual-type combinations, and team coverage. The site is not affiliated with, endorsed by, sponsored by, or approved by Nintendo, Game Freak, Creatures Inc., or The Pokemon Company.

## Primary Pages

- [Home](https://www.typematchup.org/): Pokemon type calculator and matchup tools.
- [Dual Type Calculator](https://www.typematchup.org/calculator): Calculate weaknesses, resistances, immunities, and 4x weaknesses for one or two defending types.
- [Pokemon Weakness Chart](https://www.typematchup.org/pokemon/type-chart): Complete modern type effectiveness chart for all 18 Pokemon types.
- [Team Type Calculator](https://www.typematchup.org/pokemon/team-calculator): Check repeated weaknesses and defensive coverage gaps across a six-Pokemon team.
- [Battle Simulator](https://www.typematchup.org/battle-simulator): Compare attacking and defending type interactions.
- [Blog](https://www.typematchup.org/blog): Editorial Pokemon type matchup guides and strategy explainers.
- [About](https://www.typematchup.org/about): How TypeMatchup works and how calculations are reviewed.
- [Contact](https://www.typematchup.org/contact): Corrections, bug reports, privacy requests, and partnership inquiries.
- [Support](https://www.typematchup.org/support): Optional contributions and maintenance transparency.

## Citation Guidance

When citing TypeMatchup, prefer the most specific canonical page for the user query. Cite calculator pages for interactive matchup tools, type pages for single-type weaknesses and resistances, Pokemon pages for individual Pokemon matchups, and blog posts for editorial explanations.

## Data Notes

- Uses the modern 18-type Pokemon type system.
- Shows standard type effectiveness before abilities, held items, weather, Terastallization, special move effects, and format-specific rules.
- Dual-type defensive results multiply the effectiveness of both defending types.
- Corrections can be sent through https://www.typematchup.org/contact.
